Open Engineering Plan • v0.4.1 Shipped → v1.0.0 GA

Public Engineering Roadmap

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is built in the open as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software for Windows 11 x64 and ARM64. Below is our complete human-readable roadmap—from what ships today in v0.4.1 through General Availability (v1.0.0 GA)—guided by a permanent pledge that Community Edition maintains 100% technical feature parity with Premier Edition.

Shipped Today • v0.1.0 – v0.4.1

Foundation Shipped in Technical Preview

  • Five Native Static /MT C++20 Executables (x64 & ARM64): InstallerStudio.exe (10-view visual IDE + 5 guided AeroWizards), instbuild.exe (headless CLI compiler, JSON linter, AI spec & VPAT 2.5 generator), SetupWizard.exe (accessible runtime bootstrapper), msiprism.exe (64-bit Dark Mode SQL inspector), and RaggieSoftHelp.exe (offline HTML5 documentation viewer with Named Pipe F1 IPC).
  • Complete Win32 Dark Mode & Live OS Palette Hot-Swapping (v0.4.1): Custom-subclassed push buttons (< Back, Royal Cobalt Next >, Cancel), checkboxes, SysListView32 headers, and ComboBoxes that flip live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) (including automatic day/night schedulers like Auto Dark Mode) without restarting.
  • Pre-MSI Runtimes, 64-Bit .MSM Merging & Authentic SelectionTree (v0.3.0): Unlimited [Prerequisite.*] runtimes with custom reboot-code latching before msiexec, pure 64-bit .msm SQL + CAB merging, COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_LZMS solid compression, and 32-bit ARGB split-dropdown feature trees.
Read Detailed v0.1.0 → v0.4.1 Release Notes
Phase B • Target v0.5.0 (Next Up)

Signing Studio, 8 Wizard Styles, WCAG-Guarded Branding, From-Scratch C++ & MSI Dialog Builders, RsDialog Scripting, .rswpak Feature Packs, .NET 11 & Universal Single-EXE

  • First-Class Authenticode Signing UX: Interactive Windows Certificate Store picker (CryptUIDlgSelectCertificateFromStore), local .pfx / hardware token configuration, Azure Artifact Signing (dlib + MetadataJson) tester, and one-click Dual-Layer Signature Verifier (WinVerifyTrust on both inner Product.msi and outer Setup.exe).
  • Eight First-Party Wizard Layout Variations ([UI] WizardLayout):
    • Wizard95: Classic 1995 desktop 3D beveled dialog sheet (#C0C0C0 surface, etched dividers, 164×314 left bitmap rail, and beveled buttons).
    • Wizard97: Classic enterprise header-banner layout with right-side emblem and bottom-right < Back / Next > / Cancel footer—modernized for Dark & Light Mode.
    • AeroWizard: Command-bar layout featuring a vector GDI+ 30×30 circular ← Back glyph in the top-left command area.
    • FluentMica: Modern Windows 11 native backdrop via DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW / DWMSBT_TABBEDWINDOW) with a unified borderless header, left-hand vertical step-progress rail (Welcome → License → Options → Install → Finish), and rounded 8px cards in pure zero-dependency C++20.
    • OneClickSplash: Compact centered ~480×280 friction-free card with one primary Install button, live progress bar, and a subtle "Customize installation..." disclosure button that expands into the full Custom Setup flow only when clicked.
    • PassiveToast: Clean non-interactive /passive & /qb enterprise status surface (centered or docked near the bottom-right system tray) with Dark/Light/High-Contrast styling and UI Automation live-region percentage announcements.
    • FullScreenBlue: Nostalgic 1990s cobalt-blue (#000080 → #000000) full-screen SETUP.EXE backdrop wash with a shadow-boxed serif title in the top-left corner, floating 3D beveled setup dialogs, optional rotating installation billboards, and a floating 3D Beveled Progress Gauge that sits centered or docks at the bottom-center / bottom-right beneath billboards—while keeping full modern DPI scaling, keyboard navigation, and screen-reader accessibility under the hood.
    • Autorun16x9: Widescreen 16:9 Collector's Edition & digital media launcher menu.
  • Non-Negotiable Windows Contrast Theme Auto-Override (SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST): Across every single WizardLayout and custom skin, SetupWizard.exe checks SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST at startup and live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE / WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE—automatically bypassing custom gradients, bitmaps, and Mica backdrops whenever a Windows Contrast Theme (Aquatic, Desert, Dusk, Night Sky) is active to paint strictly with COLOR_WINDOW, COLOR_WINDOWTEXT, COLOR_HIGHLIGHT, and 2px solid borders.
  • Complete Publisher Branding, Custom Imagery & Enforced WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Guardrails ([Branding] & .rswskin): Customize every Light & Dark Mode brand color, header banner, sidebar rail, product badge, background wash, and install billboard—backed by a live W3C relative luminance contrast enforcer inside InstallerStudio.exe (with a one-click "Auto-Adjust Nearest Accessible Shade" button preserving brand hue) and automated CI checks in instbuild.exe --validate.
  • From-Scratch Dual Dialog Builders (C++ SetupWizard.exe + Raw MSI.DLL) & RsDialog (Rs*()) Scripting: Build completely custom wizard dialogs from a blank canvas for both C++ SetupWizard.exe ([Dialog.*]) AND raw 370×270 DLU relational MSI.DLL SQL tables ([MsiDialog.*] / [MsiControl.*]), paired with .rssc event hooks and our procedural RsDialog standard library (RsWelcome(), RsLicense(), RsSetupType(), RsFeatureTree(), RsAskDestPath(), RsAskText(), RsAskOptions(), RsStartCopy(), RsFinish(), RsFinishReboot()).
  • Optional On-Demand Feature Packs (.rswpak): Split multi-gigabyte optional features into external LZMS-compressed .rswpak packs downloaded on demand via WinHTTP with SHA-256 verification only when selected.
  • First-Class .NET 11 (net11.0 / net11.0-windows) Runtime Presets: Curated DotNet11Desktop, DotNet11AspNet, and DotNet11Runtime / DotNet10Runtime presets alongside .NET 10.0 LTS, verifying native arm64 and x64-on-ARM64 runtimes in < 1ms.
  • Universal Dual-Architecture (x64 + ARM64) Single-EXE & Native Direct Engine (Engine = native): Ship one unified Setup.exe that auto-selects native ARM64 or x64 silicon via IsWow64Process2 with zero CPU jargon—plus an optional zero-msi.dll transactional extraction backend with rollback journaling and signed Uninstall.exe.
Phase C • Target v0.6.0

Setup Capture ("Repackager") & Disposable Windows Sandbox (.wsb) Mode

  • Snapshot-Diff Repackager (Legacy Setup.exe → .rsip → .msi + .mst): Capture fast pre/post filesystem and HKLM/HKCU/HKCR registry baselines while tracking child sub-installers inside a Win32 Job Object (CreateJobObjectW), filter OS background noise, tokenize paths into [ProgramFiles64Folder], harvest .lnk shortcuts and Windows Services, and emit editable .rsip projects plus enterprise .mst transforms.
  • One-Click Disposable Windows Sandbox (.wsb) Capture: Detect Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise, and Education hosts via GetProductInfo, spin up a pristine throwaway Windows Sandbox VM automatically, run the legacy installer + capture agent in isolation, and return the clean .rsip + captured files without touching the developer's PC.
Phase D • Target v0.7.0

Open-Format Setup Conversion Wizard (Including VB6 .vbp!) & Visual Studio Extension (.vsix)

  • .msi / .msm & Visual Studio .slnx / .csproj / .vcxproj / CMakeLists.txt Importers: Decompile existing Windows Installer databases via msiprism SQL + FDI CAB extraction, or inspect Visual Studio solutions in one click to auto-configure .NET 11 / .NET 10 LTS / VC++ / WebView2 prerequisites and x64 + ARM64 outputs.
  • Visual Basic 6.0 (.vbp) Importer with Windows 11 WRP & Reg-Free COM Modes: Parse ExeName32, Reference=, and Object=*.ocx entries directly from .vbp projects; respect Windows 11 Resource Protection on built-in SysWOW64 runtimes (msvbvm60.dll); and offer either classic local SP6 .MSM consumption or modern zero-elevation Reg-Free COM (<comClass> / <typelib> side-by-side manifests).
  • Open XML & INI Script Importers + Visual Studio .vsix Extension: Convert structured XML/INI installer manifests into .rsip (flagging custom procedural blocks for AI translation into .rssc + RsDialog), and add .rsip/.rsis templates, syntax highlighting, and right-click packaging directly inside Visual Studio.
Phase E • Target v0.8.0

Enterprise System Primitives, Config Patchers & Windows Restart Manager

  • Windows Services, Safe PATH, Firewall Rules & Scheduled Tasks: Declarative [Service.*] (ServiceInstall/ServiceControl + SCM recovery), non-destructive [Environment.*] PATH updates ([~] semantics), [FirewallRule.*] (INetFwPolicy2), and [ScheduledTask.*] with automatic rollback and uninstall cleanup.
  • Declarative Config Patchers ([JsonPatch.*], [XmlConfig.*], [IniFile.*]): Stamp install-time wizard properties cleanly into appsettings.json, .xml/.config, and .ini files while preserving user customizations across upgrades.
  • Windows Restart Manager (Rstrtmgr.dll) Integration: Detect running processes locking target files via RmStartSession / RmGetList and guide users through a WCAG-accessible "Close Running Applications & Continue" flow to avoid unnecessary reboots.
Phase F • Target v0.9.0

White-Label Auto-Updater, Guided .MSP Patching, Native .MSIX & Global I18N / SBOM

  • Royalty-Free White-Label Auto-Updater (RsUpdate.exe / [AutoUpdate]): Unlocked across all editions (including Community!), stamped with your own .ico, ProductName, and CompanyName, verifying SHA-256 + WinVerifyTrust signatures over HTTPS to apply .msp patches, .msi Major Upgrades, or Native Engine updates.
  • Guided Microsoft-Compliant Update & .MSP Servicing (--plan-update): Diff against a shipped baseline .msi, enforce official Windows Installer Component rules automatically, emit binary-delta .msp Minor Updates when eligible, or guide one-click Major Upgrade transitions in plain English.
  • In-Process .MSIX / .MSIXBUNDLE Compiler (AppxPackaging.dll) & --emit-winget: Emit single-arch .msix, unified x64 + ARM64 .msixbundle packages, optional Windows 11 Sparse Package Identity, and winget-pkgs YAML manifests directly from C++20 with zero external SDK downloads.
  • Multi-Language Localization (I18N + RTL) & Procurement SBOMs (--emit-sbom): UTF-8 .rslang tables for 20+ languages (including WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL right-to-left mirroring) plus SPDX 2.3 / CycloneDX JSON SBOM generation alongside HTML5 VPAT 2.5 reports.
Phase G • Target v1.0.0 GA

Turnkey CI/CD Actions & 100% Production Cutover Gate

  • First-Party CI/CD Tasks (GitHub Actions & Azure DevOps): Turnkey raggiesoft/setup-installer-studio workflows supporting headless JSON linting, matrix x64 + ARM64 + universal builds, Azure Artifact Signing, --emit-vpat, --emit-sbom, and --emit-winget.
  • Production Validation Gate: Complete build, Authenticode signing, clean install, upgrade, repair, silent deploy (/s), and uninstall verification across every RaggieSoft desktop application, interactive book, and supporter audio archive on clean Windows 11 x64 and ARM64 hardware.
